show.description: Romi's life is shattered when Shikha's drunken father causes a crash that kills his mother and cripples his father. Driven by revenge, Romi spends seven years tormenting Shikha through abuse, humiliation, and a forced marriage, unaware she is battling terminal cancer. As manipulative Monica schemes to destroy Shikha, Romi realizes his mistakes. Seeking redemption, he sacrifices part of his liver to save Shikha. Forgiveness, love, and atonement ultimately replace years of hatred and suffering.
